title: Design and installation documents.
officialText:
The special inspector shall become familiar with and retain a copy of the approved
construction documents, and the following items, as applicable, approved by the registered design professional of record:
1. Shop drawings.
2. Instructions for the sequence of component installation.
3. Samples and/or mock-ups, if supplied.
